conservationBoundary.normalAccounting: N=W40. BD98 adds r7 once on exclusive direct/deferred routes. ABA68 subtracts once only on exact C000, final W3Czero and W48null. Pending W48 postpones that subtraction. Known AC218 failure adds0; optional/middle/final successful submits add0/1/0. Actual root delivery and participation are additional premises.
conservationBoundary.conditionalWitness: Assume one committed add1,N=1,W3C=0,W48null,W18=W1C=0; Q0/Q1 each contain the same readable bare terminated root H with [H+4]=C000, producer1/consumer0. Consistent G/W identity, disjoint valid helper storage and no external N mutation are guards. Run CPU0 fully then CPU1. Each BB90 sets W38 to only its CPU bit and raises W3C to1; each ABA68 clears that bit before cleanup, so the other queue is not advanced, then final W3Czero/W48null subtracts. Result D=2,sum(r7)=1,N=FFFFFFFF, both queues consumed.
conservationBoundary.witnessQualification: This is a finite state-machine counterexample to an unguarded rule, not an observed run or a proved retail-wrapper construction. Actual empty wrapper roots can contain0x80 and other records. Their complete producer/mask/participation sequence must be bound before declaring the witness reachable or excluded. No global normal-producer theorem D=sum(r7) is promoted.

guards: No requested W/Q family is proved globally dispensable. Removing only the parser leaves reset, callback, lifecycle and kernel observations.
Do not label the conditional empty-root witness a reproduced or proved reachable retail defect, or confuse it with a complete producer theorem.
Do not substitute an S2 callback for the unknown W10/W14 protocol or infer absent installation from a literal scan.
conclusion: Reset, callback, shutdown and suspend positively observe W/Q state beyond replay. Kernel synchronization and unresolved8C dispatch remain real boundaries. Global conservation needs an actual producer/participation premise in addition to the local decrement rule and aggregate accounting.
